pages.title: Knight Sword
pages.text: Forged from the Knight Ingot, this massive sword hits harder than any common blade. It deals 16 attack damage with a slow but crushing attack speed of 1.6 and endures 1664 uses. Every swing is a blow your enemies will remember.

pages.title: Recipe
pages.text: A Knight Ingot on top and one in the middle, flanked by two Icora Stones, with a stick below.
